description: MONTGOMERY – Today, an Alabama judge dismissed the Democrats' residency lawsuit against Coach Tuberville, ruling that the plaintiffs’ sole legal claim — quo warranto — cannot be used at this stage to remove a certified major-party nominee from the ballot.
